items.source: A new "portable options" design pattern. We wanted to provide as much portability in the ModelCall as possible across different chat based AI Models. There is a common set of generation options and then those that are specific to a model provider. A sort of "duck typing" approach is used. ModelOptions in the model package is a marker interface indicating implementations of this class will provide the options for a model. See ImageOptions, a subinterface that defines portable options across all text→image ImageModel implementations. Then StabilityAiImageOptions and OpenAiImageOptions provide the options specific to each model provider. All options classes are created via a fluent API builder, all can be passed into the portable ImageModel API. These option data types are used in autoconfiguration/configuration properties for the ImageModel implementations.
items.translation: 一种全新的“可移植选项”（portable options）设计模式。我们希望在不同的基于对话的 AI 模型之间，尽可能地为 ModelCall 提供可移植性。这里有一套通用的生成选项，以及那些特定于模型提供商的选项。我们采用了一种类似于“鸭子类型”（duck typing）的方法。 中的 ModelOptions 是一个标记接口，指示该类的实现将提供模型的选项。参见 ImageOptions，这是一个子接口，它定义了所有文本到图像 ImageModel 实现的可移植选项。随后，StabilityAiImageOptions 和 OpenAiImageOptions 分别提供了每个模型提供商特定的选项。所有的选项类都是通过流式 API 构建器创建的，并且都可以传递到可移植的 ImageModel API 中。这些选项数据类型被用于 ImageModel 实现的自动配置/配置属性中。

items.source: A major change was made that took the 'old' ChatClient and moved the functionality into ChatModel. The 'new' ChatClient now takes an instance of ChatModel. This was done to support a fluent API for creating and executing prompts in a style similar to other client classes in the Spring ecosystem, such as RestClient, WebClient, and JdbcClient. Refer to the [JavaDoc](docs.spring.io/spring-ai/docs/api) for more information on the Fluent API, proper reference documentation is coming shortly.
items.translation: 进行了一项重大变更，将“旧版”ChatClient 的功能移至 ChatModel 中。现在的“新版”ChatClient 接收一个 ChatModel 实例。此举是为了支持一种流式 API（Fluent API），用于以类似于 Spring 生态系统中其他客户端类（如 RestClient、WebClient 和 JdbcClient）的风格来创建和执行提示词。有关流式 API 的更多信息，请参阅 [JavaDoc](docs.spring.io/spring-ai/docs/api)，正式的参考文档即将发布。

items.translation: SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY 表新增了一个 sequence_id 列（类型为 BIGINT，在 Oracle 中为 NUMBER(19)，在 SQLite 中为 INTEGER）以及一个 SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY_CONVERSATION_ID_SEQUENCE_ID_IDX 索引。timestamp 列及其索引保持不变。

items.source: SpringBeanToolCallbackResolver and the pattern of declaring bare Function / Supplier / Consumer beans and referencing them by name via toolNames() have been removed. The toolNames() method has been removed from all chat options classes and from ChatClient.

items.source: Generated schemas now include OpenAPI-style format hints for primitive types (e.g., int32 for int, int64 for long, date-time for LocalDateTime), matching the format conventions used for tool calling.

items.source: In the HttpClient-based transport auto-configurations (SseHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration, StreamableHttpHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration), the SDK-level McpSyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer and McpAsyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer beans are no longer applied. Transport-level customization now goes through McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder> and McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder> respectively.
items.translation: 在基于 HttpClient 的传输自动配置（SseHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration，StreamableHttpHttpClientTransportAutoConfiguration）中，SDK 级别的 McpSyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer 和 McpAsyncHttpClientRequestCustomizer bean 不再被应用。传输层级的自定义现在分别通过 McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder> 和 McpClientCustomizer<HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder> 进行。

items.source: The internalToolExecutionEnabled option has been removed from ToolCallingChatOptions and all provider-specific ChatOptions classes (e.g. OpenAiChatOptions, AnthropicChatOptions). The corresponding Spring Boot configuration property spring.ai.<provider>.chat.internal-tool-execution-enabled has also been removed.
items.translation: internalToolExecutionEnabled 选项已从 ToolCallingChatOptions 以及所有特定供应商的 ChatOptions 类（例如 OpenAiChatOptions、AnthropicChatOptions）中移除。相应的 Spring Boot 配置属性 spring.ai.<provider>.chat.internal-tool-execution-enabled 也已被移除。

items.source: User-controlled loop via ChatModel directly — simply invoke ChatModel without ToolCallingAdvisor. Tool calls will not be executed automatically; check chatResponse.hasToolCalls() yourself and drive the loop with ToolCallingManager.

items.source: A new JsonHelper class has been introduced in spring-ai-commons as the canonical way to perform JSON serialization and deserialization. It is instantiable and accepts a custom JsonMapper, making it straightforward to customize JSON behavior per use case. JacksonUtils gains a new getDefaultJsonMapper() static method that returns a shared, pre-configured JsonMapper instance.
items.translation: 在 spring-ai-commons 中引入了一个新的 JsonHelper 类，作为执行 JSON 序列化和反序列化的标准方式。 它是可实例化的，并接受自定义的 JsonMapper，使得针对特定用例定制 JSON 行为变得非常简单。 JacksonUtils 获得了一个新的 getDefaultJsonMapper() 静态方法，该方法返回一个共享的、预配置好的 JsonMapper 实例。

items.source: The individual toolCallbacks() methods on ChatClientRequestSpec and defaultToolCallbacks() on ChatClient.Builder are deprecated in favour of tools(Object…​) / defaultTools(Object…​).
items.translation: ChatClientRequestSpec 上的 toolCallbacks() 方法以及 ChatClient.Builder 上的 defaultToolCallbacks() 方法已被弃用，取而代之的是 tools(Object…​) / defaultTools(Object…​)。

items.source: When using ChatClient, the .options() / .defaultOptions() methods now accept a ChatOptions.Builder (or any provider-specific builder subtype) rather than a fully built ChatOptions instance. This change is enforced at compile time by the method’s generic type constraint <B extends ChatOptions.Builder<?>>.
items.translation: 在使用 ChatClient 时，.options() / .defaultOptions() 方法现在接受 ChatOptions.Builder（或任何特定于提供商的 builder 子类），而不是完全构建好的 ChatOptions 实例。 此更改通过方法的泛型类型约束 <B extends ChatOptions.Builder<?>> 在编译时强制执行。

items.source: The transition should be seamless, and no major breaking changes are expected for existing users of the spring-ai-openai module. All properties (with the spring.ai.openai.* prefix), builders, and options remain fully intact. The existing extraBody configuration parameter transparently maps to the underlying additionalBodyProperties in the openai-java SDK.
items.translation: 过渡应当是无缝的，对于 spring-ai-openai 模块的现有用户，预计不会有重大的破坏性变更。 所有属性（带有 spring.ai.openai.* 前缀）、构建器和选项均保持完整。现有的 extraBody 配置参数将透明地映射到 openai-java SDK 中底层的 additionalBodyProperties。

items.source: McpSchema.Tool.inputSchema() (and outputSchema()) now returns Map<String, Object> instead of the former JsonSchema record. This allows arbitrary JSON Schema dialect keywords ($ref, unevaluatedProperties, vendor extensions) to round-trip without being trimmed.
items.translation: McpSchema.Tool.inputSchema()（以及 outputSchema()）现在返回 Map<String, Object>，而不是之前的 JsonSchema 记录。 这允许任意 JSON Schema 方言关键字（如 $ref、unevaluatedProperties、厂商扩展）在往返传输过程中不被裁剪。

items.source: For most applications the change is transparent. The Maven artifact, the spring.ai.anthropic.* configuration, and the AnthropicChatModel / AnthropicChatOptions / ChatClient API are preserved, and code that goes through ChatClient or ChatModel.call(Prompt) does not need updates.
items.translation: 对于大多数应用来说，这一变化是透明的。Maven 构件、spring.ai.anthropic.* 配置以及 AnthropicChatModel / AnthropicChatOptions / ChatClient API 都被保留，且通过 ChatClient 或 ChatModel.call(Prompt) 执行的代码无需更新。

items.source: AnthropicCacheType, StreamHelper, and metadata.AnthropicRateLimit were removed; the equivalent SDK types (CacheControlEphemeral, AsyncStreamResponse<RawMessageStreamEvent>, RateLimitException) are used directly.
items.translation: AnthropicCacheType、StreamHelper 和 metadata.AnthropicRateLimit 已被移除；现在直接使用等效的 SDK 类型（CacheControlEphemeral、AsyncStreamResponse<RawMessageStreamEvent>、RateLimitException）。

items.source: In WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider, WebMvcStatelessServerTransport, and WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider, the Map<String, List<String>> passed to securityValidator.validateHeaders(headers) now has all header names normalized to lowercase.
items.translation: 在 WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider、WebMvcStatelessServerTransport 和 WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider 中，传递给 securityValidator.validateHeaders(headers) 的 Map<String, List<String>> 现在已将所有请求头名称规范化为小写。

items.source: The type of the portable chat options (frequencyPenalty, presencePenalty, temperature, topP) has been changed from Float to Double.
items.translation: 可携带聊天选项的类型（frequencyPenalty、presencePenalty、temperature、topP）已从 Float 更改为 Double。

items.source: A Spring Boot auto-configuration (spring-ai-autoconfigure-tool-search-advisor) and matching starter (spring-ai-starter-tool-search-advisor) are now available. When enabled, ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor replaces the default ToolCallingAdvisor in the auto-configured ChatClient, limiting the tool definitions sent to the LLM per call to only the most relevant ones (via keyword or semantic search).
items.translation: 现在提供 Spring Boot 自动配置 (spring-ai-autoconfigure-tool-search-advisor) 和匹配的 starter (spring-ai-starter-tool-search-advisor)。 启用后，ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor 将替换自动配置的 ChatClient 中的默认 ToolCallingAdvisor，将每次调用发送给 LLM 的工具定义限制为最相关的工具（通过关键词或语义搜索）。

items.source: ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate (previously deprecated since 2.0.0) and its default implementation DefaultToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate have been removed. These interfaces combined an options-based policy check (internalToolExecutionEnabled) with a response check (hasToolCalls()). Since the options-based flag is gone, there is no replacement at the ChatModel level.
items.translation: ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate（自 2.0.0 版本起已弃用）及其默认实现 DefaultToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate 已被移除。这些接口结合了基于选项的策略检查（internalToolExecutionEnabled）和响应检查（hasToolCalls()）。由于基于选项的标志已被移除，因此在 ChatModel 层级上没有替代方案。

items.source: A new spring.ai.chat.client.tool-calling.enabled property (default true) controls whether the ToolCallingAdvisor is auto-registered by the auto-configured ChatClient. Set it to false to disable automatic tool execution for all calls — tools are still sent to the AI model as definitions, but tool call responses are not executed automatically.
items.translation: 一个新的 spring.ai.chat.client.tool-calling.enabled 属性（默认值为 true）用于控制由自动配置的 ChatClient 是否自动注册 ToolCallingAdvisor。 将其设置为 false 可禁用所有调用的自动工具执行——工具仍作为定义发送给 AI 模型，但工具调用响应不会被自动执行。

items.source: Options classes (like ChatOptions, EmbeddingOptions, etc.) are now strictly immutable. Collections within options (like toolCallbacks, stopSequences, customHeaders) are now stored as unmodifiable collections. Additionally, nullable collections are now used instead of empty ones to better represent the absence of a value.
items.translation: Options 类（如 ChatOptions、EmbeddingOptions 等）现在是严格不可变的。 选项中的集合（如 toolCallbacks、stopSequences、customHeaders）现在以不可变集合的形式存储。 此外，现在使用可空集合代替空集合，以更好地表示值的缺失。

items.source: The elicit(…​) overloads that previously accepted tools.jackson.core.type.TypeReference<T> in McpAsyncRequestContext and McpSyncRequestContext now accept org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference<T>.
items.translation: elicit(…​) 在 McpAsyncRequestContext 和 McpSyncRequestContext 中先前接受 tools.jackson.core.type.TypeReference<T> 的重载现在接受 org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference<T>。

items.source: A ToolAdvisor marker interface has been added. ToolCallingAdvisor implements it. DefaultChatClient checks for this marker to decide whether to auto-register a ToolCallingAdvisor — if any advisor in the chain already implements ToolAdvisor, auto-registration is skipped.
items.translation: 添加了一个 ToolAdvisor 标记接口。ToolCallingAdvisor 实现了该接口。DefaultChatClient 会检查此标记以决定是否自动注册 ToolCallingAdvisor —— 如果链中的任何顾问已经实现了 ToolAdvisor，则跳过自动注册。

items.source: The conversation ID is no longer optional for the built-in memory advisors (MessageChatMemoryAdvisor and VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor). Every call through these advisors must supply ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID via the advisor context. If the value is absent or null, the advisor throws an IllegalArgumentException immediately.
items.translation: 内置内存顾问（MessageChatMemoryAdvisor 和 VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor）的会话 ID（conversation ID）不再是可选的。 通过这些顾问进行的每一次调用都必须通过顾问上下文提供 ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID。 如果该值缺失或为 null，顾问将立即抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

items.translation: 常量 CHAT_MEMORY_CONVERSATION_ID_KEY 已重命名为 CONVERSATION_ID，并从 AbstractChatMemoryAdvisor 移动到了 ChatMemory 接口中。请更新您的导入以使用 org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID。

items.source: Content, MediaContent, and Media have moved from org.springframework.ai.model to org.springframework.ai.content.
items.translation: Content、MediaContent 和 Media 已从 org.springframework.ai.model 移动到 org.springframework.ai.content。

items.source: Provides AI capability abstractions: - Interfaces like ChatModel, EmbeddingModel, and ImageModel - Message types and prompt templates - Function-calling framework (ToolDefinition, ToolCallback) - Content filtering and observation support
items.translation: 提供 AI 能力抽象： - 诸如 ChatModel、EmbeddingModel 和 ImageModel 的接口 - 消息类型和提示词模板 - 函数调用框架（ToolDefinition、ToolCallback） - 内容过滤和观测支持

items.source: any tool passed via the functions() method or the functionCallbacks() of the default FunctionCallingOptions instance is now handled in the same way: it is included in each call to the model from that ChatModel instance, possibly overwritten by runtime options. With that, there is consistency in the way tools are included in calls to the model and prevents any confusion due to a difference in behavior between functionCallbacks() and all the other options.
items.translation: 任何通过 functions() 方法或默认 FunctionCallingOptions 实例的 functionCallbacks() 传递的工具现在都以相同的方式处理：它们将被包含在从该 ChatModel 实例发出的每次模型调用中，并可能被运行时选项覆盖。由此一来，工具在模型调用中的包含方式保持了一致性，并防止了因 functionCallbacks() 与所有其他选项之间的行为差异而产生的任何混淆。

items.source: If you are upgrading to Spring Boot 3.4.2, please make sure to refer to this documentation for the changes required to configure the REST Client. Notably, if you don’t have an HTTP client library on the classpath, this will likely result in the use of JdkClientHttpRequestFactory where SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory would have been used previously. To switch to use SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory, you need to set spring.http.client.factory=simple.
items.translation: 如果您正在升级到 Spring Boot 3.4.2，请务必参考此文档中关于配置 REST Client 所需的变更。值得注意的是，如果您在 classpath 中没有 HTTP 客户端库，这可能会导致系统使用 JdkClientHttpRequestFactory，而此前使用的是 SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory。若要切换回使用 SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory，您需要设置 spring.http.client.factory=simple。

items.translation: 我们将“旧版”的 ModelClient 重命名为 Model，并重命名了实现类，例如将 ImageClient 重命名为 ImageModel。Model 的实现代表了在 Spring AI API 和底层 AI 模型 API 之间进行转换的可移植层。

items.translation: ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker (Function<ChatResponse, Boolean>) 现在可以在 ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder 上进行设置，用于自定义工具调用循环的迭代时机。默认值为 chatResponse → chatResponse != null && chatResponse.hasToolCalls()。

items.source: The JdbcChatMemoryRepository schema adds a sequence_id BIGINT column that determines message ordering within a conversation. Previously, ordering relied on the timestamp column, but TIMESTAMP precision differs across databases — on MySQL and MariaDB the default precision is one second, so messages saved within the same second were returned in a non-deterministic order. A dedicated integer sequence orders identically across every supported database.
items.translation: JdbcChatMemoryRepository 的架构增加了一个 sequence_id BIGINT 列，用于确定对话中的消息顺序。此前，排序依赖于 timestamp 列，但不同数据库的 TIMESTAMP 精度各不相同——在 MySQL 和 MariaDB 上，默认精度为一秒，因此在同一秒内保存的消息返回顺序是不确定的。而专门的整数序列可以在所有支持的数据库中保持一致的排序。

items.source: Building on the chat configuration changes described above, the configuration properties for all other models (Embedding, Image, Audio, Moderation, OCR, etc.) no longer use the .options prefix. For example, the former spring.ai.openai.embedding.options.model is now spring.ai.openai.embedding.model. Deprecated configuration properties are provided for the .options variants to ensure a smoother migration experience.
items.translation: 基于上述所述的聊天配置更改，所有其他模型（Embedding、Image、Audio、Moderation、OCR 等）的配置属性不再使用 .options 前缀。 例如，以前的 spring.ai.openai.embedding.options.model 现在变为 spring.ai.openai.embedding.model。 为了确保更平滑的迁移体验，提供了包含 .options 变体的弃用配置属性。

Code that sets .internalToolExecutionEnabled(true) (explicitly enabling the internal loop) will no longer compile, and the behaviour it implied no longer exists — per-model internal tool execution has been removed from all ChatModel implementations.

items.translation: ToolCallingAdvisor 通过 ChatClient（推荐）—— 当存在工具时自动注册；无需标志。

items.source: If you implemented ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate to customize when tool execution fires, migrate to ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker (see below) and supply it to ToolCallingAdvisor.
items.translation: 如果您实现了 ToolExecutionEligibilityPredicate 来自定义工具执行的触发时机，请迁移到 ToolExecutionEligibilityChecker（见下文）并将其提供给 ToolCallingAdvisor。

items.source: When streamToolCallResponses=true, intermediate tool-call request chunks were streamed downstream but the paired ToolResponseMessage (sent back to the LLM) was not. Any downstream memory advisor that recorded those chunks would receive a tool-call request without the corresponding tool response, producing a corrupted conversation history. The design flaw cannot be fixed without introducing a breaking change to ChatClientResponse, so the option has been removed entirely.
items.translation: 当 streamToolCallResponses=true 时，中间的工具调用请求分片（tool-call request chunks）被流式传输到下游，但与之配对的 ToolResponseMessage（发送回 LLM 的响应）则没有。 任何记录了这些分片的下游内存顾问（memory advisor）都会收到一个没有对应工具响应的工具调用请求，从而导致对话历史损坏。 由于如果不引入破坏性变更（breaking change）到 ChatClientResponse 就无法修复此设计缺陷，因此该选项已被完全移除。

items.source: The timestamp column is retained. It now stores the message creation time and is exposed in the message metadata under the JdbcChatMemoryRepository.CONVERSATION_TS key (a java.time.Instant), so applications can display when a message was created. The timestamp is preserved across saves: re-saving a conversation keeps each existing message’s original creation time.
items.translation: 保留了 timestamp 列。它现在存储消息的创建时间，并作为消息元数据中的 JdbcChatMemoryRepository.CONVERSATION_TS 键（类型为 java.time.Instant）进行暴露，以便应用程序可以显示消息的创建时间。时间戳在保存过程中得以保留：重新保存对话时，每条现有消息的原始创建时间都会被保留。

items.source: Adapt the identifier quoting and the row-identity expression (ctid above) to your database. The ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY <timestamp>) pattern reproduces the existing per-conversation order on every supported engine. Alternatively, since chat memory holds recent conversation context rather than permanent history, you can drop and recreate the table from the updated schema-<platform>.sql script.
items.translation: 根据您的数据库情况，调整标识符引用和行标识表达式（如上文中的 ctid）。ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conversation_id ORDER BY <timestamp>) 模式可以在所有支持的引擎上重现现有的每条会话顺序。或者，由于聊天记忆保留的是最近的对话上下文而非永久历史，您可以根据更新后的 schema-<platform>.sql 脚本删除并重建表。

Default configuration properties in *Properties classes have been removed as they are no longer needed and should be consistent with the options-level defaults.
items.translation: 选项的默认值（如默认模型名称、temperature 等）已从 Model 实现和 *Properties 配置类移动到选项构造函数本身。 *Properties 类中的默认配置属性已被移除，因为它们不再需要，且应与选项层级的默认值保持一致。

items.translation: toOptions() 方法已从嵌套的 Options 类移动到根 *Properties 类。

items.source: Update your application.properties or application.yml to remove the .options segment from the property keys.
items.translation: 更新您的 application.properties 或 application.yml，从属性键中移除 .options 段。

items.source: The N() builder method in various *Options and configuration properties classes has been renamed to n() to align with Java naming conventions.
items.translation: 在各种 *Options 和配置属性类中，N() 构建方法已重命名为 n()，以符合 Java 命名规范。

items.translation: JsonParser（位于 org.springframework.ai.util.json）已被标记为即将移除。所有方法现在都委托给 JsonHelper。

items.source: McpJsonParser (in org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.method.tool.utils) has been deleted. Its functionality is now covered by JsonHelper.
items.translation: McpJsonParser（位于 org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.method.tool.utils）已被删除。 其功能现由 JsonHelper 提供支持。

items.source: GoogleGenAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails has been moved from org.springframework.ai.google.genai to org.springframework.ai.google.genai.embedding.
items.translation: GoogleGenAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails 已从 org.springframework.ai.google.genai 移动到 org.springframework.ai.google.genai.embedding。

items.translation: 添加了一个 MemoryAdvisor 标记接口。BaseChatMemoryAdvisor 现在继承了该接口。DefaultChatClient 使用此标记来检测下游的 memory advisors，并在存在此类 advisor 时禁用 `ToolCallingAdvisor` 的内部对话历史。

items.translation: 被标注为 @JsonProperty(required = false) 的属性，包括未指定 required 属性的 @JsonProperty 声明，不再被视为必填项。

items.source: the metric/span attribute gen_ai.operation.name has value execute_tool instead of framework.
items.translation: 指标/跨度属性 gen_ai.operation.name 的值为 execute_tool，而不是 framework。

items.source: The constant ChatMemory.DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_ID (value "default") has been removed from the ChatMemory interface.
items.translation: 常量 ChatMemory.DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_ID（值为 "default"）已从 ChatMemory 接口中移除。

items.source: The .conversationId(String) builder method has been removed from MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder and VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder. Setting a default conversation ID at construction time is no longer supported.
items.translation: .conversationId(String) 构建方法已从 MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder 和 VectorStoreChatMemoryAdvisor.Builder 中移除。 不再支持在构造时设置默认的 conversation ID。

items.translation: 将 PromptChatMemoryAdvisor 替换为 MessageChatMemoryAdvisor。其 builder API 完全相同。 MessageChatMemoryAdvisor 不再将记忆作为纯文本注入到系统提示词中，而是直接将对话历史作为聊天消息包含在提示词中。

items.translation: 已弃用的 Builder.customizeRequest() 方法已从 HttpClientSseClientTransport.Builder 和 HttpClientStreamableHttpTransport.Builder 中移除。

items.source: AnthropicChatOptions#maxTokens defaults to 4096 instead of 500. Responses that hit the old cap will now run longer, with correspondingly higher token usage.
items.translation: AnthropicChatOptions#maxTokens 的默认值改为 4096 而非 500。原本会触及旧上限的响应现在将运行更长时间，并相应增加 token 的消耗。

items.translation: AnthropicServiceTier.AUTO / STANDARD_ONLY 用于 Anthropic 的优先容量层级。属性为 spring.ai.anthropic.chat.service-tier。

items.translation: McpSyncClientConfigurer 和 McpAsyncClientConfigurer 的构造函数现在接受 List<McpClientCustomizer<…​>>，而不是原来的特定类型的列表。

items.translation: 关键点：对话历史由LLM用于理解上下文并构建回复，而非由工具本身使用。工具仅接收其输入参数以及您明确提供的任何自定义上下文。

The Spring AI autoconfiguration has changed from a single monolithic artifact to individual autoconfiguration artifacts per model, vector store, and other components.
This change was made to minimize the impact of different versions of dependent libraries conflicting, such as Google Protocol Buffers, Google RPC, and others.
By separating autoconfiguration into component-specific artifacts, you can avoid pulling in unnecessary dependencies and reduce the risk of version conflicts in your application.

通过将自动配置拆分为特定组件的构件，您可以避免引入不必要的依赖，并降低应用程序中出现版本冲突的风险。

items.source: This restriction applies to ChatClient only. When calling ChatModel.call(Prompt) directly, the prompt must carry a fully built ChatOptions instance of the concrete type expected by the model (e.g. AnthropicChatOptions for AnthropicChatModel). No partial merging occurs at the ChatModel level.
